integrity: The published source and classical spectral calculus are distinguished from the specific new arithmetic cluster-profile claim. Analytical proof is included; numerical checks only corroborate it. Priority beyond inspected literature is not certified.
scientific_limitations: The exact error and cluster laws apply to positive diagonal compact generators with one geometric spectral sequence or two geometrically incommensurate sequences, and to fractional-power Hilbert source balls; general spectra and other norms are not classified.
title: Sharp log-periodic and quasiperiodic relaxation on compact spectral source balls
